name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-taskqueue
description: Client-level task queue: dump non-urgent ideas, auto-execute during off-peak (cheap) windows, at set times, or right after a container restart (--on restart / -r / when="restart" (v0.6.1 adds the single-dash -r alias for iOS), detected via PID1 starttime change, one attempt per restart); v0.4.0 adds /queue RPC channel (list/edit/cancel/runnow) for the editable queue panel in dsh-notice-banner; v0.5.0 adds queued-sending state (dispatched but still waiting in target session inbox) that remains cancelable — cancel withdraws the queued message via Inbox.remove; v0.7.0 adds off-peak travel mode (错峰出行模式): when enabled in settings, all messages sent during peak hours are auto-queued via /queue RPC add instead of reaching the LLM — client bundle intercepts session.prompt; v0.8.0 adds per-session bypass (单会话豁免, mode.exempt RPC + exempt map in offpeak-mode.json, toggle in the input-row pill next to the Full access select) and moves the notice from the floating dock above the input into the composer row with a matching input-card border tint (:has() CSS) — local helper plugin, not an official package; v0.8.1 (2026-09-02) narrows the pill text on mobile (viewport ≤640px shows only the status word 高峰/平峰/豁免 instead of the full label) and makes the pill shrink-safe inside the composer tool row so it no longer overflows onto neighbouring controls
